meaning: to worry about someone or something
core: Native speakers use 担心 to express anxious concern for someone's safety or a pending outcome, usually directed at a person or situation the speaker cares about. Learners often overuse it to describe generic work-related worry, where 发愁 or 着急 sounds far more natural.

sentences.situation: At home · to your child returning late
sentences.zh: 你怎么才回来？我很担心你。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zěn me cái huí lái ？ wǒ hěn dān xīn nǐ 。
sentences.en: Why are you only just back? I was so worried about you.
sentences.why: A parent says this to a child who comes home far past the expected time, expressing that their anxiety is now easing.
sentences.tip: Stress 很 to show how strong your worry was; do not say 我害怕你 here, which would mean you are scared of the child.

sentences.situation: At the office · to a new colleague
sentences.zh: 这个报告你不用担心，我来帮你。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge bào gào nǐ bù yòng dān xīn ， wǒ lái bāng nǐ 。
sentences.en: Don't worry about this report, I'll help you with it.
sentences.why: An experienced team member says this to a new hire who is stressed about finishing a work task, taking responsibility to help them.
sentences.tip: 不用担心 is softer and more natural for work than 别担心 here, as it frames the task as something the other person does not need to stress over.

sentences.situation: On a call · to your friend who is sick
sentences.zh: 你身体好点了吗？大家都很担心你。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ shēn tǐ hǎo diǎn le ma ？ dà jiā dōu hěn dān xīn nǐ 。
sentences.en: Are you feeling any better? Everyone is worried about you.
sentences.why: A friend calls to check in on someone who was recently unwell, passing along shared care from the whole friend group.
sentences.tip: Add 大家 to show concern comes from the whole group, not just you, which feels warm and sincere.

sentences.situation: On a WeChat message · to your roommate going on a trip
sentences.zh: 路上注意安全，别让我担心哦。
sentences.pinyin: lù shàng zhù yì ān quán ， bié ràng wǒ dān xīn ó 。
sentences.en: Stay safe on the trip, don't make me worry about you.
sentences.why: A close roommate sends this lighthearted message before the other travels, showing they care without being overly dramatic.
sentences.tip: The final 哦 softens the line so it does not sound like a strict scolding.

sentences.situation: At a restaurant · to your colleague who just choked on food
sentences.zh: 你刚才没事吧？我真的担心死了。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ gāng cái méi shì ba ？ wǒ zhēn de dān xīn sǐ le 。
sentences.en: Are you okay just now? I was absolutely scared to death.
sentences.why: A dining partner says this right after someone has a small choking or food incident, expressing how intense their momentary fear was.
sentences.tip: The structure 担心死了 is a common colloquial exaggeration for extreme worry, used only for close friends or family.

sentences.situation: At a client meeting · reassuring an overseas client
sentences.zh: 您放心，交货时间不用担心，我们会按时完成。
sentences.pinyin: nín fàng xīn ， jiāo huò shí jiān bù yòng dān xīn ， wǒ men huì àn shí wán chéng 。
sentences.en: Rest assured, don't worry about the delivery timeline, we will finish on schedule.
sentences.why: A sales representative says this to a client who is nervous about project timelines, making a clear, formal guarantee to build trust.
sentences.tip: Pair 您放心 with 不用担心 for a very polite, reassuring tone appropriate for client communication.

sentences.situation: At home · to your teen who came home with a minor injury
sentences.zh: 摔成这样怎么不早说？真让人担心。
sentences.pinyin: shuāi chéng zhè yàng zěn me bù zǎo shuō ？ zhēn ràng rén dān xīn 。
sentences.en: You fell and hurt yourself this bad, why didn't you tell me earlier? You really make people worry.
sentences.why: A parent says this when they notice their teen's injury long after it happened, mixing mild irritation with underlying concern.
sentences.tip: The phrase 真让人担心 is a classic parental line that sounds like gentle scolding rather than real anger.

sentences.situation: On a WeChat group chat · joking with friends
sentences.zh: 大家别担心，我只是开个玩笑而已。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā bié dān xīn ， wǒ zhǐ shì kāi gè wán xiào ér yǐ 。
sentences.en: Everyone stop worrying, I was just making a joke.
sentences.why: A friend says this after posting a silly fake dramatic story that made the group react with concern, lightening the mood.
sentences.tip: Add 而已 at the end to frame your prank as small and harmless, so no one gets genuinely upset.

sentences.situation: At the office · reporting to your boss during a project delay
sentences.zh: 这个项目虽然有点慢，但是不用担心，我会搞定的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge xiàng mù suī rán yǒu diǎn màn ， dàn shì bù yòng dān xīn ， wǒ huì gǎo dìng de 。
sentences.en: This project is a bit behind schedule, but don't worry, I'll get it sorted out.
sentences.why: An employee updates their boss on a slight delay, proactively taking ownership to stop the boss from worrying about missed deadlines.
sentences.tip: Use 搞定 for a casual work setting to sound confident and capable, without sounding arrogant.

sentences.situation: At home · comforting your parent after a false alarm about your health
sentences.zh: 我这不是好好的吗？您就别白担心了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhè bù shì hǎo hǎo de ma ？ nín jiù bié bái dān xīn le 。
sentences.en: Look, I'm totally fine, aren't I? You didn't need to worry for nothing.
sentences.why: An adult child says this to their parent who panicked over a minor health scare that turned out to be nothing, gently easing their parent's overconcern.
sentences.tip: 白担心 means worrying for no reason; use it only with close family, as it can sound rude if said to a colleague or stranger.

quiz.prompt: Your friend calls to say they are nervous about an upcoming job interview. Tell them not to worry, you believe they will do great.
quiz.answer: 别担心，我觉得你肯定能面试得很好。
accept: 不用担心，你这么优秀，面试肯定没问题的。
别担心，准备得这么充分，你肯定可以的。
quiz.explain: Starting with 别担心 is the most natural, casual way to comfort a friend about a stressful upcoming event.

quiz.prompt: Your child comes home 2 hours late without texting you. Tell them you were very worried about them.
quiz.answer: 你怎么才回来？我特别担心你。
accept: 你这么晚才到家，我真的很担心你。
你没按时回来，我担心了好久。
quiz.explain: Expressing strong worry about a late family member is a natural use of 担心 for personal safety concerns.

quiz.prompt: A client is anxious that your team will miss their delivery deadline. Politely reassure them they do not need to worry, and that you will deliver on time.
quiz.answer: 您不用担心，我们肯定会按时交货的。
accept: 请您放心，交货的事不用担心，我们会按计划完成。
您不用担心，我们一定会准时把货送到。
quiz.explain: Using 您 and 不用担心 gives a polite, professional reassurance that builds client trust.

quiz.prompt: Your roommate went hiking in the rain and came home soaked. Tell them they really make you worry when they do that.
quiz.answer: 下这么大雨还去爬山，真让人担心。
accept: 你冒雨爬山，真的太让人担心了。
你淋成这样回来，真让人担心。
quiz.explain: 真让人担心 is the natural phrase to express gentle, caring concern for a close friend's risky choices.

quiz.prompt: 你妈妈给你打电话，说她刚才差点出小车祸，现在已经没事了。你要先问她伤没伤着，告诉她你刚才特别担心。
quiz.answer: 妈，你没受伤吧？我刚才听到消息担心死了。
accept: 妈，你没事吧？我刚才真的担心坏了。
你没碰着吧？我接到电话的时候特别担心你。
quiz.explain: Using colloquial phrases like 担心死了 shows genuine, intense worry appropriate for a close family member in a small emergency.

quiz.prompt: 你的同事问你，这个延期的项目会不会影响季度考核。你告诉他不用太担心，你已经和领导沟通过了。
quiz.answer: 不用担心，我已经跟领导说过了，不会影响考核的。
accept: 你不用太担心，我和领导沟通过了，这个延期没关系。
别担心，我已经跟领导解释清楚了，不会有问题的。
quiz.explain: Reassuring a worried colleague with 不用担心, paired with a concrete explanation of what you have done, sounds natural and supportive at work.
